channel.title: Treasure Coast Today

item.description: Port St. Lucie Police Department is investigating a double fatal shooting that occurred early Sunday morning in a residential neighborhood. item.title: Safe Kids Treasure Coast offering free pool alarms to Martin County residents
item.description: The Florida Department of Health and Safe Kids Treasure Coast are providing a limited supply of free pool alarms to qualifying Martin County residents with residential pools.

item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Boca Raton TLC Program Offers Summer Service Projects for South Florida Families
item.description: B'nai Torah Congregation's TLC Program connects volunteers with hands-on service projects ranging from food support and shoe donations to pantry stocking and literacy efforts.

item.title: Two Martin County brush fires contained, more expected this summer
item.description: Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike, both now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: St. Lucie County Fire District terminates 3 firefighters, suspends 2 others after hazing investigation
item.description: Three firefighters were terminated and two others suspended following an investigation into allegations that senior firefighters used a modified bug zapper to administer electric shocks to probationary firefighters.

item.description: The annual Fort Pierce event brought together families with community services and public safety demonstrations.

item.title: Indian River County families can apply for free or reduced-price student meals starting July 15
item.description: Families in Indian River County are able to apply for free or reduced price meals for students starting July 15.
